description: This file defines the OverridesEntityForm class for Drupal's Layout Builder module, providing a form interface for editing layout overrides with methods for form building, saving, and messaging.

classes.name: OverridesEntityForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing layout override entities within the Layout Builder module, supporting form display, save, and messaging functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for entity repository, bundle info, time, and layout tempstore repository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form class with services from the container.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form display, including revision message components if applicable.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the layout override form, adding attributes and a message at the top.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Creates a message informing the user about the layout being edited, with a link to edit the default template if accessible.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the form and performs additional save tasks with a confirmation message.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, including a revert button and hiding the delete option.
